title: BridgeWorks Campus
one_line: Walk the campus road from Class 8 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then build a real-physics bridge and test it with traffic.
how_to_play: Pick your class, tap its building, answer questions to earn parts, tap two joints to place a member, then press Test bridge. Guide, Hint and Show me lead you step by step; Forces shows the pushes and pulls at any joint.
description:
BridgeWorks Campus is a foundation for an engineering career, built as a game. One campus road runs from Class 8 to 12, then BE, NIT, IIT and Expert Engineer. Each building has its own questions: 14,500+ questions across physics, chemistry, maths, geography, economics, commerce, accountancy, computer and engineering, a bridge quiz for every project, and an Edge tab of hard questions from the class's whole syllabus.

Right answers earn bridge parts. Then you build: one bridge project per class, from a cable bridge in Class 8 to a two-tower bridge for a line of trucks in Class 12 and beyond. Real engineering maths checks every beam as traffic drives across: does it snap, get crushed or bend, and arrows show the pushes and pulls at every joint. The school physics you just answered becomes something you can see and test.

It plays in English and Bengali, with guided steps, hints, stars, unlocks, badges, a daily streak, a weekly bridge challenge and a printable report card for teachers. Works offline once loaded; nothing is tracked.
controls: Tap a building to open its questions
Tap two joints to place a beam
Test bridge sends the traffic across
Guide, Hint and Show me lead you step by step; Forces shows any joint
tips: Triangles keep a bridge stiff; squares fold.
Beams that turn red are close to breaking: add support there.
Play the bridge quiz first, it explains the project.
Use the Edge tab to revise before exams.
story: I want students to see why their physics and maths matter. Every right answer becomes a bridge part, and the bridge either stands or snaps, so learning has a real result. It starts at Class 8 and keeps going to engineering college level as one path, learned through play.
